name: Pixly API
description: Turn listing photos into staged photos and short videos. Typical flow: POST a tool with imageUrl → if the answer is 202, poll the job until status is "completed" → download resultUrls. Generation tools spend credits from the account's Pixly balance. Full reference: https://pixly.app/docs.md
